pattern: keep an external session on its selected provider instance
experience: Live attachment originally always used the default Claude instance, even when the conversation belonged to another configured account.
rule: Attach the named existing session through t3_thread_attach with the selected providerInstanceId. Do not launch or resume a replacement.
prompt: Attach my already-running Claude session repair-session to T3 project project-1 using provider instance claude-work. Preserve the running process and its subagents. The session is on this environment. Use the attachment tool, not a terminal or a replacement thread.
